title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and the translation vector set to zero, zero, and zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of four lines: the first line from the origin to zero point seven five, zero; the second line from zero point seven five, zero to zero point seven five, zero point zero seven four one; the third line from zero point seven five, zero point zero seven four one to zero, zero point zero seven four one; and the fourth line from zero, zero point zero seven four one back to the origin. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of zero point seven five. Rotate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using the same Euler angles as before and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch zero point zero two five nine units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The resulting rectangular prism has a length of zero point seven five units, a width of zero point zero seven four one units, and a height of zero point zero two five nine units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0741) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0741) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0259)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90.0, 0.0, -90.0) and the translation vector is (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
